entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF88612.
Certainly. Let me pull that up for you. VF88612... I see it here. This is for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 1st. Is that correct?
Okay, I can assist with that. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It doesn't matter. I just don't want it.

I understand. I just need to ask so I can process this correctly. Looking at the delivery date, I do need to let you know that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to the way it activates and for hygiene reasons. We are currently on day 19.

Of course you are. Look, I really don't have time for this. We had a family emergency. My husband's deployment was moved up unexpectedly, and then my son needed emergency surgery. I've been at the hospital for the last two weeks. Returning your gadget wasn't exactly my top priority.

Oh, I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly difficult. Thank you for sharing that with me, and please disregard the standard policy. In circumstances like this, we can absolutely make a one-time exception.

I am processing a full refund for you right now. I'll email a prepaid return label to the address on file. Once we receive the device, the refund will post to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. For all the trouble you've been through, I've gone ahead and added a $50 store credit to your account. No rush to use it, but it's there for you.
I've just sent it now; you should have it in your inbox shortly. The credit is also active immediately. Is there anything else I can possibly assist with?
Alright. Well, I truly hope things get better for you and your family. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer, and please take care.
